About Expedite Healthcare Solutions

Our Commitment to Excellence

Expedite Healthcare Solutions is a Joint Commission certified, minority- and woman-owned healthcare staffing and Health IT consulting company. We connect hospitals, clinics, and health systems nationwide with qualified travel nurses, allied health professionals, and clinical and non-clinical staff placing talent in an average of 5 days with a 97% retention rate. Our experienced recruiters and pre-credentialed talent pipeline help healthcare organizations maintain optimal staffing levels, improve patient outcomes, and modernize their technology infrastructure.

Learn More

PROVEN RESULTS

Real-World Success Stories

See how our solutions have transformed businesses around the globe.

Optimizing Clinical Workforce with Allied Healthcare Staffing

"Expedite Healthcare Solutions transformed our staffing challenges into a competitive advantage. They placed 40+ qualified nurses across our facilities in under 60 days, and the retention rate has been exceptional. Their understanding of healthcare compliance and credentialing made the entire process seamless."

David K., Chief Information Officer
Multi-Site Health System

"We needed to unify five different EHR systems after a series of acquisitions, and Expedite's Health IT team delivered beyond expectations. Their interoperability solution eliminated data silos, and our clinicians now have real-time access to complete patient records across every facility."

Priya S., VP of Human Resources
Healthcare Staffing Agency

"Finding qualified allied health professionals in a competitive market felt impossible until we partnered with Expedite. Their dedicated recruiters filled critical radiology and lab positions that had been vacant for months, and their retention support program has kept turnover well below industry averages."
